movie.title: Aria-Remix
movie.overview: When struggling DJ Aria (Bonnie Hill) is targeted by a mysterious cult, she finds herself possessed by an ancient Lovecraftian deity who uses her music as a portal to enter our world and consume our reality.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When struggling DJ Aria is targeted by a secretive cult, she becomes possessed by an ancient Lovecraftian deity that uses her music to breach our reality.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Struggling musician Aria's world turns upside down when a mysterious cult sets their sights on her. Upon becoming possessed by an ancient Lovecraftian entity, her electronic beats transform into a terrifying gateway for cosmic horror. As the deity channels its apocalyptic power through her tracks, Aria must navigate the chaos threatening to consume both her identity and the world around her.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Aria is a talented yet struggling DJ trying to make a name for herself in the competitive music scene. Her life takes a dark turn when a mysterious cult targets her for a sinister ritual, seeking to unleash an ancient threat. Before she can escape their grasp, Aria becomes possessed by a Lovecraftian deity of immense, reality-bending power. The malevolent entity discovers that Aria's music provides the perfect sonic frequency to act as a portal into our dimension. As her career suddenly takes off, each of her live sets unknowingly weakens the fabric of space and time. Unaware of the true peril, her growing audience succumbs to the hypnotic trance of the cosmic music. While grappling with personal relationships and her own fading autonomy, Aria must fight a desperate internal battle to regain control of her mind. Ultimately, she faces an extraordinary choice between her artistic ambition and saving humanity from absolute consumption.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Aria-Remix is a genre-bending blend of comedy, romance, fantasy, and horror that follows the turbulent journey of an underground DJ on the rise. After a bizarre encounter with a shadowy cult leaves her possessed by a cosmic, Lovecraftian entity, Aria discovers that her original music has the terrifying power to open interdimensional portals. Balancing the chaotic demands of her personal life and emerging career with cosmic horror, Aria must find a way to silence the ancient terror raging within her music before it destroys reality.

story_structure.resolution: The immediate supernatural threat is confronted, leaving Aria and her world fundamentally altered by the cosmic forces unleashed.
story_structure.introduction: Struggling DJ Aria attempts to break into the music scene while navigating her daily personal and professional challenges.
story_structure.risingAction: As her tracks gain eerie traction, Aria fights to maintain control over her own body and mind while unraveling the cult's dark plans before her performances unleash cosmic horrors.
